notes.title: Inferno Climber Full Release, Version1.0.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25502139/6a5f4351b30663c5b6cbfbcaec4c69abef4fc83b.png[/img]
[h1]Inferno Climber is now available on Steam![/h1]
Thanks to everyone's support during the early access, Inferno Climbler full game is now on Steam. We hope for your continued support. Thank you once again.
The following additions and changes have been implemented the full release:

[h1]New Additions[/h1]
[list][*]Added all levels leading up to the ending.
[*]Added hidden secrets.
[/list]
[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
[list][*]Adjusted such that blue chest do not break due to opening and closing it in a specific manner.
[*]Added swing sound to spear's strong attack.
[*]Added restriction to option menu access during scenes which are not suitable.
[*]Added signboard in "Grave of Origin".
[*]Added NPC.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a bug whereby an item of a dead character is lost when "return to title screen" on the menu is selected at "Death and Rebirth".
[*]Fixed a bug whereby player loses health at "Death and Rebirth".
[*]Fixed a bug whereby player is able to move when displaying the contents of the inventory at "Death and Rebirth".
[*]Fixed issue whereby required item to progress through the game is lost; Required items now appears in the tent area in "Mountain Base" if issue occurs.
[*]Fixed an error on the Map whereby some connection between areas are incorrect.
[*]Fixed a bug where certain data gets carried over when starting as a new game, such as the nests' eggs.
[*]Fixed bug whereby sand smoke effects persist after defeating a certain boss.
[*]Modified such that essential items are not destroyed along with the destruction of tomb at "Death and Rebirth".
[*]Fixed issue whereby sword attack is able to activate switch from the back a wall.
[*]Fixed bug whereby water effects persist after "Return Bottle" is used.
[/list]

Thank you for your support. Please enjoy Inferno Climber.

notes.title: Announcement for full version release and price adjustment
notes.content:
[b][u]<Official Release Confirmed>[/u][/b]
Inferno Climber would be switching from early access to full version release on the 8th Sep 18:00～20:00(PDT).

Players will be able to enjoy the complete content in the full version.
Also, the Early Access Special Price will end, and the price will be reverted to the original USD$29.99, with a launch discount to be revealed at a later date.
Kindly note that the discounted price during the launch sale period will still be higher than the Early Access Special Price.

[b][u]<Important Notice>[/u][/b]
To facilitate the transition, the following procedures will be implemented in this order:
1. The price of the game will set to USD $29.99 a couple of days before the full version release.
2. The game will then be released to the full version.
3. The launch discount will be applied shortly after the release.

Please be aware that due to implementation time gaps, the game will temporarily be at the full price of USD $29.99 at certain time intervals while we work out the release. 
We seek for your patience in this matter.

notes.title: Version0.3.04 Update (2016/9/1)
notes.content:
The following additions and changes have been implemented in this patch:

[u]New Additions[/u]
[list][*]Player could now customize the behavior of equiping bone after consuming meat at "Death and Rebirth" by pulling a switch. By default, player is equiped with a bone automatically.
[/list]
[u]Adjustments[/u]
[list][*]Increased the health of some bosses. 
[*]Changed level design for "Grave of Hunters" partially.
[*]Adjusted some poisonous mushrooms in the forest such that they are not as weak against fire.
[*]Changed the state of the poisonous mushrooms in the forest to persistent.
[*]Placed Emphasis on the price figure when player is selling items.
[*]Highlighted CP required to power up weapon at the smith.
[/list]
[u]Fixes[/u]
[list][*]Fixed issue whereby player is burned but there is no damage over time.
[*]Fixed issue whereby switch could be activated from the backside of the wall at "Mountain Base".
[*]Fixed issue whereby player equipped with rapier is able to execute the strong attack while accessing the menu.
[*]Fixed issue at "Death and Rebirth" whereby player could not proceed or close the selection window.
[*]Fixed issue whereby enemy continues to face the PC direction after attacking player from the back.
[*]Fixed issue whereby boomerang throw could go through walls.
[*]Fixed issue at the "Black Fortress" whereby at  some walls are not displayed correctly.
[*]Fixed bug whereby enemy would fall through the ground after grabbing the player.
[*]Fixed bug whereby sand dust effects are created at unintended areas of the desert.
[*]Fixed bug whereby sand dust effects stays on the player for a long time when they jump at a specific time.
[*]Fixed bug whereby player is able to jump right after reappearing from pitfalls.
[*]Removed unnecessary model data information displayed at "Death and Rebirth".
[*]Fixed bug whereby net shot by parasite do not open up.
[/list]

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and thank you for your support.
